summary.en: Replace inherited instance behaviour while preserving a method’s contract.
summary.bn: প্যারেন্টের মেথডের চুক্তি বজায় রেখে চাইল্ডে কাজের ধরন বদলান।

notes: Covariant reference returns and @Override are available on Java 17; no preview features are used.

sections.title: Keep the request, change the response
Separate the callable contract from the receiver
Compare replacement, extension and a new overload
Preserve what callers were allowed to rely on
Overriding and overloading answer different questions
Replace a method without breaking its promise

examples.title: A revised lab fee
examples.explanationHtml: The Fee variable refers to a LabFee object. The overridden instance method returns 750.

examples.title: Reuse part of the inherited message
examples.explanationHtml: The override widens access and appends detail. super.text() calls Slip.text() once.

examples.title: A covariant return keeps useful type information
examples.explanationHtml: LabCopy is a subtype of Copy, so the overriding return type may be LabCopy. Primitive return types cannot change this way.

examples.title: An overload leaves the inherited signature intact
examples.explanationHtml: label(String) adds another signature. It does not replace label(int), so the first call still uses Report.

practice.title: Hostel fee override
practice.statementHtml: Read base fee (0..10000) and meal fee (0..5000). Store base in HostelFee and override total() in MealPlanFee to include meals. Use a HostelFee reference and print total.
hints: The override has the same parameter list as the parent method.

practice.title: Format two result labels
practice.statementHtml: Read mark (0..100). Result.label(int) returns Mark followed by a space and the mark. HonoursResult overrides it, adding ! when mark is at least 80. Print labels from a Result and an HonoursResult, one per line.
hints: Only the suffix policy belongs in HonoursResult.

practice.title: Spot an accidental overload
practice.statementHtml: Parent defines public int score(int n). Child defines public int score(long n). Is this overriding? Explain what @Override would reveal.
practice.answerHtml: The parameter types differ, so Child adds an overload. Parent.score(int) remains available. Adding @Override to score(long) produces a compile error because no matching superclass signature is being overridden.
hints: Compare parameter types before comparing method names.

practice.title: Access and return rules
practice.statementHtml: A parent declares protected Number value(). Compare public Integer value() and private Number value() as child declarations.
practice.answerHtml: public Integer value() is a valid override: access widens and Integer is a subtype of Number. private Number value() is invalid because it reduces access. Neither changes the empty parameter list.
hints: An override must remain usable by callers allowed by the parent.

quiz.prompt: Which fee method runs through the parent variable?
quiz.explanation: Instance method selection follows the ExtraCharge object.

quiz.prompt: Does super.tag() call the child again?
quiz.explanation: super.tag() selects Tag.tag(), producing A before B is appended.

quiz.prompt: Which signature accepts the integer argument here?
quiz.explanation: The double overload does not override pick(int). The base signature is selected and inherited.

quiz.prompt: What does @Override make the compiler check?
quiz.explanation: The annotation catches spelling and signature mistakes without changing dispatch.
options: That the method runs before its parent
That the method overrides or implements a supertype method

quiz.prompt: Which access change is allowed when overriding protected void save()?
quiz.explanation: Public widens access. Package-private and private narrow it, while int changes the return type incompatibly.

quiz.prompt: Which parent method cannot be overridden?
quiz.explanation: final prevents subclasses from replacing the instance implementation.

quiz.prompt: How are same-signature static methods related across parent and child?
quiz.explanation: Static method selection uses the named type; it is hiding, not instance dispatch.
options: The child hides the parent static method

quiz.explanation: A reference return may narrow to a subtype. Primitive and void returns must match exactly.

quiz.prompt: Which checked-exception rule applies to an override?
quiz.explanation: Callers compiled against the parent cannot be forced to handle new broader checked exceptions.
options: It may not add broader checked exceptions
It must throw every parent exception
It may add any checked exception
It must never throw runtime exceptions

quiz.explanation: Changing only a return type does not create a Java overload.
options: By their parameter lists at compile time

keyPoints.en: An override keeps the inherited parameter signature.
keyPoints.bn: ওভাররাইডে প্যারেন্টের প্যারামিটার সিগনেচার একই থাকে।

keyPoints.en: @Override detects accidental overloads and spelling errors.
keyPoints.bn: @Override ভুল বানাও এবং অনিচ্ছাকৃত ওভারলোড ধরতে সাহায্য করে।

keyPoints.en: An override cannot reduce inherited access.
keyPoints.bn: ওভাররাইড করে মেথডের অ্যাক্সেস কমানো যায় না।

keyPoints.en: Reference return types may narrow covariantly.
keyPoints.bn: রেফারেন্স রিটার্ন টাইপ সাবটাইপে সীমিত করা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Static hiding and instance overriding follow different selection rules.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্যাটিক হাইডিং আর ইনস্ট্যান্স ওভাররাইডিংয়ের নির্বাচন নিয়ম আলাদা।

examQuestions.question: Compare overriding and overloading with signature, selection time and inheritance requirements.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
PropertyOverridingOverloading
ParametersSame signatureDifferent lists
SelectionRuntime instance dispatchCompile-time signature choice
InheritanceSupertype relation neededCan occur in one class

examQuestions.question: A parent returns Object. A child returns String with the same parameters. Explain legality.
examQuestions.answerHtml: String extends Object, so the reference return is covariant. The child must also keep sufficient access and obey the exception restrictions. The caller may still store the returned String in an Object variable.

examQuestions.question: Explain why an override that calls this.text() to obtain parent text recurses, and repair it.
examQuestions.answerHtml: this.text() selects the current object’s override again. Use super.text() to call the immediate parent implementation explicitly, then append the child information. Repeated self-calls without a stopping condition eventually exhaust the call stack.
